subject: OvenWare renewal: sprint commit conversion + safety net options
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwoodinference.com>
To: Grace Liu <grace@ovenware.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-18T10:17:00-07:00
Subject: OvenWare renewal: sprint commit conversion + safety net options

Grace —

Thanks again for the candid conversation yesterday. Per our renewal cadence, OvenWare's annual commit comes up at the end of September; you mentioned focusing on a shorter-term conversion for Q4 to support the product launch and optional burst coverage through peak season.

To make that pragmatic for both teams, I propose a two-part structure we can land quickly:

1) Sprint conversion (3 months): convert 40% of your current annual commit into a time-limited quarterly commit at a 14% effective discount. This preserves unit economics while giving you runway for launch.

2) Safety net / burst overlay: a temporary burst pool (up to 2x baseline for 6 weeks) priced at a fixed uplift (30% over committed rate) with automatic draw triggers and a usage floor credit if not used.

If that sounds reasonable I can pull together a term sheet and a quick mutual action plan with dates for engineering sign-off, invoice alignment, and DocuSign. I’ve looped Marissa and Ben to model the numbers and confirm operational readiness.

Thanks,

— Irene
Irene Choi
Head of Renewals, Redwood Inference
(Attachment stub: none yet)

From: Grace Liu <grace@ovenware.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Schultz <t.s@ovenware.com>, Procurement <procure@ovenware.com>
Date: 2026-08-18T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: OvenWare renewal: sprint commit conversion + safety net options

Irene —

Thanks — that two-part structure is close to what the team needs. A couple items to flag from our side:

- Can you show the blended price impact vs our current commit (incl. the effective discount math)?
- We need a short price-hold window (90 days) after signing for any significant rate changes while we finalize integration tests.
- Procurement will require an ops SLA note around region failover and KV-cache privacy for the launch window.

I can pull legal/procurement into a quick sync if Marissa/Ben are ready to share a term sheet.

Best,
Grace Liu
VP Product, OvenWare
(Attachment: usage-report request)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Grace Liu <grace@ovenware.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-19T09:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: OvenWare renewal: sprint commit conversion + safety net options

Hi Grace —

Appreciate the clarity. Attached is a draft term sheet and a usage summary for the prior 12 months; I modeled three scenarios so you can see the P&L swing:

- Scenario A (baseline): renew full annual commit at current rates
- Scenario B (sprint conversion): 3‑month 40% conversion with 14% discount, 90‑day price hold post-sign
- Scenario C (hybrid): smaller sprint (25%) + extended safety-net pricing with credits if unused

Key callouts in the sheet:
- We’ll hold rates for 90 days post-execution (price-hold clause) for the lines in the sprint conversion.
- Burst overlay is pre-authorized usage priced at a fixed uplift; unused burst capacity triggers a 25% notional credit applied to the subsequent invoice.
- Operational readiness: engineering needs a canary window (two 48‑hour rolling tests) during the first week after cutover; we’ve scheduled capacity for that.

Attachment: OvenWare_Renewal_TermSheet_v1.pdf (term sheet)
Attachment: usage-summary-2025-2026.csv

If this looks directionally right I’ll update the DocuSign package and propose a 48‑hour window for legal redlines.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Principal Commercial, Redwood Inference
(Attachments: OvenWare_Renewal_TermSheet_v1.pdf, usage-summary-2025-2026.csv)

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
To: Grace Liu <grace@ovenware.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-20T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: OvenWare renewal: sprint commit conversion + safety net options

Grace —

Thanks for the quick review. A few operational notes so procurement has concrete answers:

- SLA & failover: we’ll provide a one‑page appendix summarizing cross-region failover, KV cache isolation, and audit logging for the launch window; Sean will own the ops checklist.
- Finance: we’ll draft the invoice schedule aligning the 3‑month sprint payment with your billing cycle and include conditional credit vesting for unused burst.
- DocuSign: Marissa will send the envelope today; HubSpot deal updated: DEAL-2026-1137 (link below). Please have legal circulate any redlines within 48 hours so we can meet your cutover timeline.
